column1: # The 8c tools the hand-off names, each pinned by the commit it is taken from and its blob there (sitting2.sh refuses unless
# <commit>:<path> is that blob). Final Oct 9 (the laptop session): the cloud's switch-2 queue is done, so every tool is taken at
# the round-2 branch tip 31380294 (results only on top of P = 31616338). Since 056158c3: the classifier and its tests carry the
# review's fixes (8106a900), classify_8c.py and coin_lookahead.py are the round-2 copies (c012104e, 8106a900), and
# score_dump_round2.rs is the gate run's (31380294; 056158c3's blob did not compile). Reader one's second read (Oct 9) named these.
# Left out: rl/results/round2_readiness_2026-10-02/validate_v2.py (it reads round 1's REACH names; PLAN.md section 6 change 1).
# Still to add before 8c: the revert-check driver (reads lookahead.tsv, picks the gate from the probe's finding, records a pass or
# fail per game); the pin refuses without it.
# Oct 10: the classifier, its tests, classify_8c.py and coin_lookahead.py are now 8c's own copies in tools_8c/ (Sonnet's
# aec85ae5: control_clean = nothing_found; the copies import the tightened_rule beside them), pinned at the main commit that
# added them; the revert-check driver and the hand-off adapter (with their tests) added. 8c order: handoff_for_classify.py, then
# classify_8c.py from tools_8c/, then revert_8c.py on lookahead.tsv (tools_8c/README.md).
